records.subject: Welcome aboard, North Media
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: Admin is responsive and says setup is "on our list this week" (email:72a12d7e), kickoff held (calendar:7c8f7713), 8 days left on an active Pro plan. But at day 6 there's still no project, no invite, and intent has already slipped once, so roughly even odds unaided.

draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Thanks for the update — totally understand that getting everyone set up takes a bit of time. Since it's on your list this week, the simplest starting point is one project with a few real tasks; in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you so nothing stalls on your end.

Best,
Chidi
